original_text:
Just like storing data in the right format matters, so does storing knowledge in your brain the right way! If your mind is a messy CSV instead of a well-indexed Parquet file, good luck retrieving anything under pressure.

Lately, I had to revise on Hadoop Data formats - CSV, Parquet, and ORC, trying to keep track of it all was a mess—until I started using mindmaps. They turn scattered information into something you can actually recall—whether it’s for an interview, debugging, or just making sense of things.

So instead of letting another deep dive disappear into the void, here’s my mindmap on storage formats (like how Parquet’s columnar magic makes analytics faster). Check it out—what’s your go-to format to recall what you read? 👇

🔖 Bookmark this link and expand on it as you gain more knowledge on these formats!

#BigData #CloudComputing #Learning #Mindmaps
